note: A short little window for revival after the house is cleaned. Short is never defined, so the window cannot close on him.
He acknowledges the provoking and prays against the retaliation rather than forecasting it, which means a non-event reads as prayer working.
A named comparison to a removal that had already happened five days earlier, which makes it a real forecast rather than a general prayer.
A declaration rather than a sighting. Kept separate from the Taiwan claims that describe an invasion, because this one asserts the opposite outcome.
Gives a motive that contradicts the official one: billions in minerals rather than national security.
Adds the two flags joining with Greenland keeping its own, which is a specific form of union rather than annexation.

Important discrepancy inside his own telling: here twenty five thousand dollars is a yearly figure, where the 9 January version had it as a one-off sum in the agreement. The elders against young split is repeated.
Europe influencing them to say no, with the French president and the man over England named.
Names France, Germany, Italy and England as the strongest voices and calls it a strong arm piece, which is the same wording as the standing instruction not to strong-arm.
A specific mechanism rather than a mood: the territory traded against Ukraine, with the Greenlanders themselves having no say.
The mining half is checkable; the getting in line for the Antichrist half is not, and is the kind of frame that absorbs any outcome.
He rules out the missile dome reading himself and names the dollar instead, then adds soon it will be Cuba, which is a forward step rather than a restatement.
Adds gas rights as the reason America stays with Israel over Gaza, and about to see, which is the tightest timing the claim carries.
Adds an Air Force and Army base like a town, on the Iraq pattern, with the oil wells secured.
Adds Marines in fatigues guarding the oil wells against the cartel.
Adds the yellow and tropical imagery, with the admission that he does not understand what it looks like.
Adds ideology and bondage as the obstacle, with the Egypt comparison. Recorded as the escape it also is: it supplies a reason for any delay in the revival.
An aside about where the audience is watching from.
The plague named in passing while explaining why they came on earlier. Marked unsure because nothing is added and the scale is not restated.
Adds deep sea fish surfacing as the sign. Deep sea fish strandings are reported regularly with no quake following, so the base rate makes this close to unfalsifiable in practice.
Japan being split again. He notes the viral video with five hundred and thirty five thousand views in the same breath, which is worth recording as the context in which the warning is repeated.
Adds the regime change attempt and the identification of the leader by his hair. He says for whatever reason, which marks it as something he did not expect to see.
Adds the demonic layer over Venezuela suppressing the people. Recorded in his favour that he volunteers he has never been there and does not know whether there is much occult activity.
He frames the whole operation as strategy rather than as a word, which is a distinction he does not always make. Seeded separately for that reason.
Adds the oil rigs in the Gulf and ties it to a destabilisation of the BRICS bloc. He works the word rigs out with his co-host.
Adds the speculation that the devil visited the others too. Nothing here can be checked.
At 3 January 2026 this predates the current first mention of 6 January 2026. Venezuela spreading through Brazil and all of South America, given as the Lord speaking.
Puts the removal inside a religious shaking of the country rather than a political one.
Adds the army suppressing it, China coming in and a window of opportunity. He corrects himself from translated to teleported mid-sentence, which is worth recording.
Recorded in his favour that he flags his own state, saying he is trying not to be scattered but is tired and has not slept.
Ties the three at the central bank to the spirit's hands being loosed and to a regime change.
Adds the COVID on steroids comparison and the judgement that COVID was a cakewalk by comparison, which sets a scale the claim can be measured against.
Adds a cyber or major event running alongside it, and that the warning comes to him repeatedly.
Not the Antichrist but will look like it cannot be scored either way. The picture shown to support it was made with AI by his co-host, which is worth recording as the kind of confirmation offered.
Adds the plane and the twenty four billion corrupted alongside the hundred million in cash.
Adds Portland with buildings in British Columbia crumbling. The first half of the passage, a woman's political career ending abruptly, is left unscored here because he never names her.
Submarine eruptions occur constantly and are rarely reported, so almost any later report could be read as the sign. Recorded with that caveat rather than as a forecast.
Adds great pride having set in and the Lord saying he will humble them, alongside the revival.
An aside about speaking invitations and the time of day.
Adds poking the bear and shooting at the Kremlin as the provocation, and names the response as a weapon of mass destruction on Poland. He marks it as the number one thing to pray about.
A sign-off and a call to subscribe.
Given on 5 July 2025 while he is repeatedly seeing Cuba and asking why. Shaking is not defined, which limits what can be scored.
Adds the heavy European connection. Recorded in his favour that he says outright he does not know what he is looking at.
Adds the Pope to the group and puts war around the Ukrainian president.
An unnamed figure kept in the mix against his own preference. Nobody is named in this passage, so nothing here can be checked.
An aside offering to keep praying past the hour he said.
He loses the thread and says he blew it and is out. Recorded because an admission of losing it mid-flow is the kind of thing this record should keep.
Adds the sweating grey-headed man and the charge that they are faking it. He asks his co-host for the man's name rather than knowing it, which weakens the identification.
Canada coming into America with fifty gallon barrels rolling and breaking. The barrels are not interpreted, so only the first half carries content.
Adds Switzerland and Spain to the grouping.
The racket of war given as the Lord's phrase, with the assignment put back on the audience. Nothing here can fail, and it moves responsibility for the outcome onto the viewers.
Coming to the table to defuse rather than to make peace, with the American president kept out while he tries to have influence.
Nothing is said beyond the two names. Marked unsure and low confidence because there is no content to attach to any Taiwan claim.

Not scored as the earliest telling: 7 December 2024 already carries one. A major earthquake fixing to take place in Japan, with no timing. Japan records several strong quakes a year, so the base rate for a hit on this wording is high.
Ties the awakening to the film's release and to the cinemas. The release is publicly scheduled, so only the revival attached to it is his own.

He says he warned about the troops, but the deployment was already being reported and he cites an article sent to him in the same breath, so this is confirmation after the fact rather than a forecast.
The misattribution is the checkable part and is unusually specific: not just an attack, but an attack publicly blamed on the wrong party.
Adds the box cars with open doors. The thirty thousand figure is attributed to what they are saying rather than to what he saw, which he states himself.
Adds the old Soviet Union framing and the refusal of any peace agreement. Eventually carries no window.
The vote was public and in progress as he spoke, so reading it as the end times unfolding is commentary on a known event rather than a forecast.

Two things at once: a criticism of prophetic voices who repeat what they heard elsewhere, and a same-day warning of a terrorist attack on 3 July 2025. The window is as tight as anything in this corpus and is now past due.

Recorded in his favour: he states the miss out loud, saying they have not seen two hundred dollar oil yet, rather than dropping the claim. He then offers mercy or prayer as the reason, which is the escape, but the acknowledgement itself is real.
Offered as scriptural necessity rather than as something he saw, which he says himself.
Doctrine rather than sighting: a beast system, the Antichrist and watching the fig tree, all sourced to scripture.
Adds Turkey saying they should not have done that and turning against, with Iran and Russia alongside.
Puts the number at ten major cities and says they are in the country right now, which is a present-tense factual claim rather than a forecast.
Another birthing pain, with nothing named. The framing accommodates any outcome, which is why it recurs.
Prayer over the cinemas for the greatest outpouring they have never seen, which extends the film claim into a revival claim.
Adds a breathing on the Abrahamic covenant. Recorded that he says he will tell them what he hears even though many will not like it, which he pairs with the position rather than with a sighting.
